searchText: <@301186049323958275> Hello, I want sync mainnet beacon chain fastly by checkpoint, but I don't known what checkpoint url I can use, Could you help me? Is there a trusted checkpoint url to use? Unfortunately the current checkpoint sync mechanism is kinda broken IMO. I don't know where to get a checkpoint sync node, and you have to trust it almost entirely IIRC. You may want to ask around in ethstaker discord server. <@301186049323958275> Thank you ! The level of trust is not that much: you get a state and a block, you sync immediately, and you get to check the hash that you got from may places. Only if these places differ in the hash they expose is that you need to trust someone
